independent_cleanup_boundary.membership_effect: none of these eight helpers; legacy Context and InputStatement continue providing release/free when PC is off
independent_cleanup_boundary.source_proof_limit: this ledger does not execute exception paths or establish Java build closure

preservation_contracts.rule: Scope and ephemeral owner mark freed before walking copied resources; continue after RuntimeException/Error, aggregate suppressed failures and rethrow
Variable names use Locale.ROOT; only singleton ProgramValueReference relations convert to scalar; freed variables reject access
Input source may expose no AST InputStatement, owns its own cache and returns null for no retained source
FORGET request copies labels and rejects allInputs with named labels
Filtering copies observed stacks before matching and forwards forget/free to its delegate
Observation counters never call live delegate.trackTransfer/trackRetentionObligation; grouping preserves quantity/retention expansion and slot addresses
Cleanup-only, value-only and unrelated host features omit all eight sources before source read

validation.remaining: root review/promotion; registered real-core tests incl isolated common edits/refusals; full Java/runtime closure
